text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's economy is set to take off next year, analysts said.
- Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa gets message from Kuwait's Emir on developments in the region. Kuwait's defence minister paid a brief visit to Bahrain on Tuesday.
- Crown prince attends a joint military exercise between units from Bahrain and United Arab Emirates armed forces.
- Bahrain Aluminium Extrusion Co to raise production to 21,000 tonnes by the end of 1996.
- Bahrain is conducting a study on the extent of the natural gas reserve. Bahrain is a small independent oil producer.
